prerequisites: Knowledge of machine elements and CAD.

learning_outcomes.text: The students master both volume-oriented and surface-oriented modeling of components in CAD.

Students who have successfully studied this module identify approaches to modeling methodology and implement them independently, taking into account special requirements such as modeling quality or manufacturing possibilities.
Students know methods to create models qualitatively and quantitatively in such a way that changes can be easily introduced after an evaluation.
Students create complex assemblies and components and organize modification possibilities with minimal effort.
Students work in groups to develop solutions for scientific problems and present the results with the help of meaningful documents.

syllabus_topics: Creation of surface models as a basis for thin-walled components
Simple surface models based on parametric sketches
More complex models based on parametric sketches
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a homework assignment. As part of the homework, 1-2 designs must be carried out.
